assertionSteps.title: 1. Given Admin A uses subject "admin-a" with role "FMO_ADMIN" in an isolated authenticated browser
2. And the controlled Tile fixture records the initial grid rows and persisted values
3. And Category 101 has label "category-a" and Import Map 201 has Module Name "container-a"
4. And both references belong to "FMO_ADMIN" and the Tile page category filter value is Category 101
5. And the Tile grid has record "101" owned by "FMO_ADMIN"
6. And the baseline fixture data defines "Tile Name" as "tile-089"
7. And the baseline fixture data defines "Module Path" as "/fixture"
8. And the baseline fixture data defines "Tile Path" as "/case-089"
9. And the baseline fixture data defines "Role Entities" as "E-TRADE"
10. And the baseline fixture data defines "Filter Rule" as ""
11. And the baseline Tile references use "Aplication Category" "category-a" and "Container" "container-a"
12. And the originally loaded "Tile Name" value is "OLD"
13. When Admin A clicks the button labeled "Edit" in the Tile grid row with "Record Id" "101"
14. Then the dialog titled "edit ID: 101" is visible on the Tile administration page
15. When Admin B completes a controlled concurrent update setting "Tile Name" to "NEW"
16. And Admin A fills the textbox labeled "Tile Name" with "STALE" in dialog "edit ID: 101"
17. And Admin A fills the textbox labeled "Module Path" with "/fixture" in dialog "edit ID: 101"
18. And Admin A fills the textbox labeled "Tile Path" with "/case-089" in dialog "edit ID: 101"
19. And Admin A fills the textarea labeled "Role Entities" with "E-TRADE" in dialog "edit ID: 101"
20. And Admin A fills the textarea labeled "Filter Rule" with "" in dialog "edit ID: 101"
21. And Admin A clicks the button labeled "Update" in dialog "edit ID: 101"
22. Then the alert with severity "error" in the portal snackbar displays the agreed message for a stale-record error
